text.en:
OFFICIAL GAZETTE
of Catigbian dated May, 1948, scale 1:100,000, submitted by the
District Engineer of Bohol).
The seat of government of the municipality of San
Jacinto shall be at the barrio of Catigbian.
As herein organized, the municipality of San Jacinto
shall have the following barrios: Catigbian which is the
poblacion, Jaguilanan, Ambuan, Hagbuaya, Ba-ang, Triple
Union, Alegria, Carawagan Norte, Candumayao, Buenos
Aires, Libertad, Cabanugan, San Isidro, Cambansag: Caus-
wagan Sur, Caimbang and Cansagui.
The municipalities of Antequera, Tubigon and Balilihan
will consist of their present territories minus the portions
thereof incorporated in the municipality of San Jacinto.
"This executive order shall take effect upon the appoint-
ment and qualification of the municipal mayor, vice-mayor
and a majority of the councilors thereof.
Done in the City of Manila, this 17th day of June, in
the year of our Lord, nineteen hundred and forty-nine,
and of the Independence of the Philippines, the third.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
2393
By the President:
TEODORO EVANGELISTA
Executive Secretary
